player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imaray {player_id} deg urar n Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Asekkil-ik d '{symbol}'.
Tiddi d aɣelluy n ufar n tlata tikwal di tiddi (s afus, s ajeɣti, neɣ s tɣmert).
Ma yellaɣ d tewwiḍ tlata tikwal di tiddi, at-tɣelliḍ.
Azen aseggwas-ik s useggwas '[4]' i wakken ad teskecmeḍ asekkil-ik deg takarḍa 4.
D imaray {player_id}, d '{symbol}' ɣer-k, yerna imaray nniḍen d '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asenfar n usiweḍ ur yelhi ara. Sseqdec "[cell]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Asekles n tzelɣa ur nelli ara d win.

outcome.loss: Amyurar {player_id} yexser mi ara yekfu tazelɣa!
